findings-against-prior-runs.so-what: The envelope differs by transport: the D10 run drove through stdio proxy children (in-repo hermes client) while this run drove raw HTTP against the published build. The refusal itself is identical. Future runs should record which transport the isError observation came from; the stdio side was not re-proven here.
findings-against-prior-runs.what-is-actually-true: On the published 1.42.0 build over HTTP, a refused query returns HTTP 200 with the refusal as a plain-text result and no isError flag — not isError:true.
